mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher when FEDFUNDS < 1% compared to when it is >= 1% (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year inflation rate above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases equity risk premiums and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% compared to when it is <= 3.0% (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals an accelerating labor market deterioration that increases recession risk and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 10k in 3 months compared to the baseline (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late expansion regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually), a high level of consumer spending (RSAFS) signals an overheating economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower when RSAFS is above its 90th percentile and GDPC1 growth > 2.5% annually compared to the baseline (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (the 2017 base) signals a weakening supply chain that increases recession risk and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower when INDPRO < 100 compared to when it is >= 100 (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% (FEDFUNDS) signals an imminent monetary tightening that increases equity risk premiums and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% compared to when it is <= 0.5% (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) above 1800 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher when HOUST > 1800 compared to when it is <= 1800 (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a robust economic expansion that increases equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher when both INDPRO rises > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 3 months compared to the baseline (t-test p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.
